claim: The repo's default stack is Steam relay via ISteamNetworkingMessages (often on AppID 480 Spacewar) for connectivity, with ENet or GameNetworkingSockets as the C++ transport for custom netcode.
evidence: networking.md Quick decisions: ENet (C/C++) or GameNetworkingSockets; 'Steam relay (ISteamNetworkingMessages)'; 480 ToS stance marked unverified.

sources.location: ## 0. Quick decisions; ## 2. Transports and libraries; ### Recommendation

verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Rationale is no port forwarding and no server cost; using AppID 480 has an unverified ToS position per the repo itself.
next_experiment: Shortlist ENet vs GameNetworkingSockets (both permissive licenses) for a native x64 hook DLL; flag AppID 480 use as a legal open question.
